messages.content:
You are a senior hedge-fund analyst filing statements into a library of open questions about NVIDIA and its world. For each statement, return the ids of the questions it is filed under, or an empty list. Read each question's 'takes' line: it says what that question collects. A statement filed under no question is a valid answer, not a failure: never file a statement under a question it does not bear on because no better question exists.
File each statement under the narrowest question that names its matter, and under that one only; never add a broader question beside it. A company-wide figure question (total revenue, segment revenue, gross margin, operating margin, profit, capex) takes only the company's own reported figures, guidance, estimates of that figure and management's statements about it. News about a customer, supplier, competitor, product, policy or deal is filed under the question that names that matter (an event, a policy process, a theme), or under none when no question names it. A rumour is filed exactly as a confirmed statement is.

[Item] thediplomat.com, 2026-07-02: Singaporean Police Seize $42M Bungalow in Nvidia Chip Smuggling Probe - The Diplomat – Asia-Pacific Current Affairs Magazine

[Open questions]
  - v1 (NVDA, due 2027-02-28): How much will NVIDIA’s disclosed commitments for guarantees and similar obligations to cloud providers reach in its FY2027 annual filing?
      takes: financing_amount figures, guidance, estimates and revisions for NVIDIA commitments and guarantees to cloud providers over 2026-02-01..2027-01-31, and the direct drivers of that figure stated with a size; statements about the matter 'NVIDIA cloud-provider financing and capacity partnerships' (also called AI Compute Partnership, DSX AI Factory, AI Compute Partnership Program, Firmus, Sharon AI, Lambda): NVIDIA’s financial guarantees, capacity-purchase commitments, leasebacks, and revenue-sharing arrangements with cloud providers and data-center customers. belong here under any of those names
  - v2 (NVDA, due 2027-12-31): Will NVIDIA sign or announce a financial guarantee for OpenAI’s Ohio data-center lease by 2027-12-31?
      takes: the terms, amounts, counterparties, agreements and approvals of this obligation or deal, and its steps, confirmations and denials: OpenAI Ohio data-center lease guarantee; statements about the matter 'NVIDIA cloud-provider financing and capacity partnerships' (also called AI Compute Partnership, DSX AI Factory, AI Compute Partnership Program, Firmus, Sharon AI, Lambda): NVIDIA’s financial guarantees, capacity-purchase commitments, leasebacks, and revenue-sharing arrangements with cloud providers and data-center customers. belong here under any of those names
  - v3 (NVDA, due 2027-02-24): How much financing and other commitment exposure will Nvidia report for its AI-cloud customer backstop arrangements at the FY2027 annual filing?
      takes: financing_amount figures, guidance, estimates and revisions for AI-cloud customer backstop arrangements over 2026-02-01..2027-01-31, and the direct drivers of that figure stated with a size; statements about the matter 'NVIDIA cloud-provider financing and capacity partnerships' (also called AI Compute Partnership, DSX AI Factory, AI Compute Partnership Program, Firmus, Sharon AI, Lambda): NVIDIA’s financial guarantees, capacity-purchase commitments, leasebacks, and revenue-sharing arrangements with cloud providers and data-center customers. belong here under any of those names
  - v4 (NVDA, due 2027-02-28): What will Nvidia's total revenue be in FY2027?
      takes: total_revenue figures, guidance, estimates and revisions for Nvidia total revenue in FY2027 over 2026-02-01..2027-01-31, and the direct drivers of that figure stated with a size
  - v5 (NVDA, due 2026-12-31): Will Nvidia begin shipping Vera Rubin by December 31, 2026?
      takes: steps, dates, delays, confirmations and denials of this event, and named customers' statements about receiving it: Rubin; statements about the matter 'Vera Rubin rollout' (also called Vera Rubin, Rubin): Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform production and shipment rollout. belong here under any of those names
  - v6 (chip-export-controls, due 2027-01-31): Will Chinese authorities permit Nvidia H200 chips to be sold in China by the end of FY2027?
      takes: the decisions, drafts, approvals, denials and deadlines of this process, and any statement of whether and how much the permitted or restricted activity is actually happening: Chinese permission for Nvidia H200 sales in China; statements about the matter 'H200 China sales and export controls' (also called H200, H200 China sales, China export controls): U.S. export-control clearance and Chinese market access for Nvidia H200 chips belong here under any of those names
  - v7 (NVDA, due 2027-02-28): At NVIDIA's next annual filing, how much credit-support obligation will NVIDIA have taken on through its AI compute framework?
      takes: financing_amount figures, guidance, estimates and revisions for AI compute framework credit-support obligations over 2026-02-01..2027-01-31, and the direct drivers of that figure stated with a size; statements about the matter 'NVIDIA cloud-provider financing and capacity partnerships' (also called AI Compute Partnership, DSX AI Factory, AI Compute Partnership Program, Firmus, Sharon AI, Lambda): NVIDIA’s financial guarantees, capacity-purchase commitments, leasebacks, and revenue-sharing arrangements with cloud providers and data-center customers. belong here under any of those names

Return one placement per statement id, in order.
